program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = 9.8; const t = time; const height = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const currentHeight = Math.max(0, height); const scaleY = 300; const baseY = 350; const ballY = baseY - currentHeight * 40; const ballX = 320; let motionState = "Moving up"; if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "Still for an instant"; } else if (velocity < 0) { motionState = "Moving down"; } const gravityState = "Gravity pulls down"; const objects = []; objects.push(sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 30, w: 560, h: 380, title: "Vertical Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 120, y: 350, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("mark.launch", ballX, baseY, 60, "Launch")); objects.push(sdk.line("line.guide", 100, baseY - apexHeight * 40, 140, baseY - apexHeight * 40, { role: "neutral" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "observed" })); if (Math.abs(velocity) >= 0.05) { objects.push(sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 20, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, minLength: 12, label: "v" })); } objects.push(sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 35, y: ballY }, { value: -gravity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 8, minLength: 12, label: "a" })); const calloutLines = [motionState, gravityState]; objects.push(sdk.callout(ballX + 45, ballY - 20, calloutLines, { id: "callout.toss" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionState }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed: launchSpeed, gravity: gravity, apexTime: apexTime, apexHeight: apexHeight, velocity: velocity, height: height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity continues to pull downward.
manifest.description: An animation of a ball tossed vertically upward on a height scale. A blue motion vector shortens as the ball rises, disappears at the apex, and points downward during descent. A dashed downward acceleration vector remains constant throughout.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows. Press Play again to watch the ball fall, or drag the timeline to inspect any moment.
